description: Zestawienie dotyczące liczby pacjentów chorych na zapalenie płuc oraz przewlekłe choroby dolnych dróg oddechowych is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Narodowy Fundusz Zdrowia. Zestawienie dotyczy liczby pacjentów z zapaleniem płuc i przewlekłymi chorobami dolnych dróg oddechowych w latach 2016- 2020 (rok 2020 zawiera dane do sierpnia włącznie). Dane zostały przedstawione w podziale na grupy wieków pacjentów. Coverage: Narodowy Fundusz Zdrowia. The publisher named on the listing is Narodowy Fundusz Zdrowia. Its keywords include nfz, Narodowy Fundusz Zdrowia, zapalenie płuc, ochrona zdrowia. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XML. The listing shows 2024-04-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
